rationale: As the assigning justice and the vote’s conceptual anchor (Lugar/Blum/Halleck formalism focused on state-conferred authority over the specific deprivation), Justice Thomas is best positioned to write a majority that rejects a “held out as official” test while reserving cases with formal governmental designation or control. The four dissenters are likely to coalesce around Roberts/Kagan’s objective-indicia “instrument of office” approach, with a meaningful chance of a Kagan-authored dissent and some separate writings to sharpen the limiting principles on both sides.
